info.description: What the nightly reset does, and what it leaves alone. This preview is meant to stay clean and presentable; the reset is how that happens.

options.heading: What this screen controls
options.body:
This preview is meant to stay clean and presentable. Every night at 04:00 a job deletes the demo content and rebuilds it from fixtures, so a day of visitors clicking around leaves nothing behind.

The switches below decide what that job does. Turning everything off does not break anything — it simply leaves the database as it is.

The demo content itself is not edited here. It lives in the repository, because it is far too large for a form field:

- cms/src/data/seed_videos.json — 110 videos, 155 KB
- cms/src/data/seed_images.json — 93 images, 97 KB
- cms/src/data/seed_articles.json — 12 articles, 42 KB
- cms/src/data/seed_creators.json — the 7 demo accounts

Editing content here and keeping the bulk in files would mean two places to look and one of them silently out of date, so all of it stays in the repository.

DEMO_MODE=false in cms/.env overrides everything on this page: a deployment that is not a demo should never depend on a database row to avoid having its content deleted.

enabled.description: Master switch. Off means the nightly job does nothing at all.

wipeContent.description: Delete and re-seed videos, images, articles and feed items.

options.heading: Before switching on "Wipe user content"
options.body:
This deletes everything a visitor has created — comments, likes, playlists, subscriptions, notifications and the whole chat. It cannot tell a demo account's row from a real person's, and there is no undo.

It exists because the reset previously only touched the four content types, so test data accumulated indefinitely while the content underneath it was replaced every night, leaving comments attached to videos that no longer existed.

Try it first without deleting anything:

- POST /api/feed/run-demo-reset with the header x-seed-secret
- it reports what it would delete and touches nothing
- pass {"dryRun": false} in the body only when you mean it

wipeUserContent.description: Also delete comments, likes, playlists, subscriptions, chat rooms, chat messages and notifications. Off by default because it removes anything a visitor created, and this cannot tell a demo account's row from a real one.

resetAffinityGraphs.description: Reset every user's affinity graph to the default shape.

lastRunSummary.description: What the last run actually did, so a failure is visible here rather than only in the logs.
